clo.description: CLO tranche investments: Class E, Class D, subordinated notes in CLO vehicles

equity.description: Equity instruments: preferred/common stock, units, partnership interests, LLC interests

debt.description: Direct lending positions: senior secured, unitranche, mezzanine. HPS uses bare company names without instrument keywords, so entity suffixes serve as catch-all debt markers. Checked last after warrant/CLO/equity.

known_edge_cases.description: Pipe-delimited affiliation suffix (| Non-Affiliated Issuer, | Affiliated Issuer) appeared in 2025-12-31. Earlier quarters have no pipe.
Some rows have double pipe before affiliation (e.g. 'Club Car Wash Preferred, LLC - Preferred Stock 1 | | Non-Affiliated Issuer')
Some CLO/equity identifiers have double space before dash (e.g. 'Octagon 52 Ltd  - Class ER')
Multiple positions in same issuer distinguished by trailing number (e.g. '123Dentist Inc 1', '123Dentist Inc 2'). Each is a separate loan/tranche.

reading_rules.evidence: The fund's own interest in its joint venture ULTRA III, LLC (the detached joint venture schedule): cost and fair value tagged, no term. 11 contexts, 2023-12-31 to 2026-06-30, e.g. 0001628280-26-033248 c-952 'ULTRA III, LLC (5)(20)(22) - LLC Interest | $ 421,029 | $ 426,214'. Production publishes all 11, and the fund's published total misses the filed total investments by exactly their value without them. Owner decision D15, 2026-11-19. Slice 2 Task 6.

HPS tags the commitment amount of an unfunded commitment line in its joint venture schedule with this us-gaap concept (its name notwithstanding); fair value is the only other fact, often negative. Counts as the line's term fact for this filer only. 32 contexts, 2024-06-30 to 2026-06-30, all in the joint venture schedule, e.g. 0001628280-26-033248 c-3683 'Rsource Holdings, LLC | 1st Lien Senior Secured Delayed Draw Loan | 50,000 | (1,462)'. Production publishes all 32 in the JV schedule. Measured in slice 2 Task 6: no other context of this fund at rules 4 to 9 lacks a term fact and carries the concept. Owner decision D15, 2026-11-19 (zero-value and commitment lines kept to match production; whether they belong is decided after reproduction, with D11).

Owner ruling B, 2026-11-23: in this filing a spread filed above 1 in a ratio unit (pure or utr:Rate) is already a percent; it is kept as filed, not multiplied by 100. Values at or below 1 in the same filing stay fractions. Measured 2026-11-23 on the warehouse build of a39354a8 with ruling A (warehouse/scripts/rate_rulings/q_b_scale_evidence.sql and q_b_scale_forms.sql): 5 rows filed above 1 (5.00 to 8.25, pure); on all 5 the printed number equals the tag read as a percent and the cell prints it followed by a percent sign, e.g. 'SF + | 8.25%' beside the all-in '13.06%'. 0 printed missing, 0 disagree. Applied per row: a row whose own print does not agree stays scale_not_decided (int_rate_scale; re-checked on every build by tests/rate_scale_rule_evidence.sql). Author: Claude (implementer agent), on the owner's ruling.

Owner ruling B, 2026-11-23: in this filing a PIK rate filed above 1 in a ratio unit (pure or utr:Rate) is already a percent; it is kept as filed, not multiplied by 100. Known contradiction (controller ruling R2, 2026-11-23): on 1 row of this filing (c-115) the page prints the whole coupon as PIK ('SF + | 10.00% PIK | 15.45'), and the PIK tag holds only the PIK margin, so the stored PIK rate (10.00) and cash leg (5.45) contradict the printed coupon (all PIK 15.45, cash 0). The scale is right; the row belongs to the whole-coupon class (wrapper procedure pik_margin_reading whole_coupon, left until slice 5 by the owner), which holds 44 published cash legs and 44 PIK rates that differ from production (build of 2026-11-23), 3 of them on scale-rule values (this filing and two other HPS filings).
